notes: Source structure: a single two-list block, ＜温食材＞ (lines 23-29, warm) and ＜冷食材＞ (lines 30-36, cool). Each line is prefixed by a row label (野菜 / 炭水化物 / 調味料 / タンパク質 / 飲み物 / 果物). Those six labels are NOT coded: each appears identically in BOTH the warm and the cool list, so they are structural row headers, not umbrella attributions. 根菜類 IS coded warm, because it appears inside the item list as a genuine umbrella attribution (「ニンジン、ゴボウなどの根菜類」), as is 葉野菜 (cool) and 貝類 (warm). 赤身（肉·魚）is kept as the single verbatim form used by the source (one item covering both meat and fish; the middle dot is U+00B7, not the usual ・) rather than being split into 赤身肉/赤身魚, since neither split form appears verbatim. NOT coded: (1) line 20 states color/origin heuristics (赤・黒・黄色・橙色 = warming; 白・青・緑 = cooling; cold-region/season = warming, warm-region/season = cooling) — these are rules about colors and provenance, not named foods; (2) line 15 「起きぬけにさゆ」は温活効果なし？ — a related-article headline; さゆ is a prepared beverage (§8) and the headline denies rather than assigns a nature; (3) line 90 牛乳 and line 58 スパイス/十六穀/カレー occur only in PR/advertising blocks with no direction; (4) line 22 caption 「左の4つは体を冷やす食材、右の4つは体を温める食材」 describes an image and names no foods. No serving-temperature items appear anywhere in this source. Line 20 also notes cooling foods can be turned warming by heating or by adding warming foods, but this is a preparation caveat, not a per-food direction, so no condition splits were made.
